videos.author: milanas.ai
videos.caption: 😂🎬 This is what happens when your AI actor completely forgets the script… and apparently decides to become the director instead. 😭😂 I was trying to create a romantic comedy scene for my AI mini-series. I had the characters, reference images, dialogue, camera angles, acting directions and even the exact order of who should speak. Everything was planned. And then AI said: “Thanks, but I've got a better idea.” 😂 Welcome to the reality of AI filmmaking! If you're learning how to create AI videos, write better AI video prompts, fix AI lip-sync problems, keep AI characters consistent or save AI video generation credits, you'll probably recognize this struggle. One thing I've learned while creating AI short films: even detailed prompts don't always guarantee perfect results. Sometimes the wrong character speaks, dialogue gets mixed up, or the AI completely improvises. My biggest tip? Generate short clips, keep dialogue simple, specify exactly who speaks, and direct the actors' movements while they're talking. This makes mistakes easier to identify and can help avoid wasting credits on entire scenes. And sometimes… the mistake is funnier than the actual movie. 😂 🎬 Behind the scenes of The Last Star, my AI-generated Christmas romantic comedy series. AI creators, what's the funniest thing your AI video generator has ever done?
